content:
We are back again with our weekly picks from Apple's official certified refurbished store. This channel is gaining more and more attention, offering iPhones, MacBooks, Studio Displays, and Apple TVs at discounted prices—and we're not talking about "some guy's cousin's home-built resale unit," but rather Apple's rigorous refurbishment process, complete with a full one-year Apple warranty.

Let's take a look at this week's picks we've added to our shopping cart—iPhones, MacBooks, Studio Displays, and more.

Apple Refurbished Store—This Week's Picks

***Stock of Apple Certified Refurbished products is very limited

Justin — iPhone 16 Plus, Pro, and Max

You can certainly pick up a cheaper iPhone 16 Pro from Amazon Renewed, but when it comes to refurbished iPhones, I much prefer the ones with Apple's "quality assurance." Apart from AirPods, iPhones are probably the Apple product most likely to show wear after use, so I go straight to the source for unlocked refurbished iPhones—which of course come with a full one-year Apple warranty.

The Apple Refurbished Store has quite a few iPhone 16 series models—I think this phone still has many years of useful life—starting from US$699, but the most eye-catching is the 1TB 16 Pro Max at US$1,269. That's US$330 cheaper than an equivalently configured 17 Pro Max, and US$130 less than a 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from US$699 (up to US$330 less than the 17 series)

Chance — MacBook Air

The MacBook Air is my top recommendation when friends ask me which new Mac to buy. Available in 13-inch and 15-inch (my personal favourite) screen sizes, with a comprehensive range of memory and storage configurations to suit different work needs. If you're looking for MacBook Air deals right now, Apple's refurbished store is the best value:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air, 1TB storage, 16GB memory: US$1,359 (original new price US$1,599)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air, 1TB storage, 16GB memory: US$1,529 (original new price US$1,799)
  • ...and many more configurations...

Zac — 48GB Memory MacBook Pro

Looking to save money while getting maximum memory? There are five MacBook Pro models with 48GB of memory available in Apple's refurbished store. The 16-inch M4 Pro MacBook Pro is absolutely the best value for users with high memory requirements (such as running local AI models), and it's priced well below US$3,000.

Other 48GB memory configurations feature newer and more powerful Apple silicon, nano-texture displays, and more CPU and GPU cores. The 16-inch M4 Pro MacBook Pro with 48GB memory at US$2,719 is very attractive for users with high memory requirements.

Marcus — Studio Display XDR

After a long wait, the Apple Studio Display XDR has finally arrived in the official certified refurbished store. Although this monitor dodged Apple's recent price increases, its original pricing was already not cheap, so the approximately 15% refurbished discount is genuinely appealing—especially for those looking to upgrade to Apple's 27-inch 5K display—with support for P3 and Adobe RGB colour gamuts, plus a 120Hz refresh rate.

  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR—Standard Glass—VESA Wall Mount Adapter: US$2,459 (original price US$2,899)
  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR—Standard Glass—Tilt and Height-Adjustable Stand: US$2,799 (original price US$3,299)
  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR—Nano-texture Glass—Tilt and Height-Adjustable Stand: US$3,059 (original price US$3,599)

Jeff — Apple Studio Display

The Studio Display XDR mentioned above is indeed the more appealing of Apple's two current displays, but the standard Studio Display in the Apple Refurbished Store costs a full US$1,100 less than the higher-end XDR.

The standard Studio Display's biggest selling point is its extremely minimalist all-metal-and-glass construction. While it lacks a high refresh rate, AdobeRGB support, and mini-LED backlighting, it was recently upgraded with dual Thunderbolt 5, enabling multi-device daisy-chaining. It may not offer the best value for money, but in terms of design, it's truly in a class of its own.

  • Refurbished Studio Display—Standard Glass—Tilt-Adjustable Stand: US$1,359 (original price US$1,599)

Ben — MacBook Neo

The MacBook Neo is the newest addition and is already sufficient for many everyday users. It received a US$100 price increase shortly after launch, but buying it from the Apple Refurbished Store lets you return to the original price.

  • Base model (no Touch ID): US$599 (original new price US$699)
  • Touch ID model: US$679 (original new price US$799)
  • The link above is for the silver model; other colours can be found here
